{{Clear}}

===Usage===
====Required parameters====
Paste the following code into the top of an article, filling all known fields:
<pre>{{Top|}}
{{InUniverseMedia
|image=
|name=
|author=
|editor=
|illustrator=
|artist=
|performer=
|publisher=
|release date=
|media type=
|pages=
|published in=
|genre=
}}
</pre>

*Note that the {{Para|artist}} parameter is exclusive to musician(s) responsible for creating the article subject (song), while the {{Para|performer}} parameter is for others who performed the songs professionally.

*[[Forum:CT:IU songs and artists]]
